title: Removing a dangerous tree
rule: An authorised officer may enter land and have a tree cut down or removed if it is diseased or is a danger to people or nearby property.
points: Applies to any tree, reserved or not, inside a reserve or not.
The officer may act alone or at the occupier's request, once satisfied of the facts.
On residential, commercial or industrial land the officer's employer may charge the occupier a reasonable fee.
Anyone who caused the tree's condition stays liable in civil or criminal law.
